description: This 2026 BMW M4 Competition is a rear-wheel-drive performance coupe powered by a 3.0-liter M TwinPower Turbo inline-six producing 503 horsepower and 479 lb-ft of torque, paired with an 8-speed M Steptronic automatic. It sprints from 0 to 60 mph in 3.8 seconds and is electronically limited to 155 mph (180 mph with the M Driver's Package). Finished in Brooklyn Grey Metallic over a Black Merino leather interior, it features M Carbon bucket seats, a carbon-fiber roof, carbon-fiber interior and exterior accents, the Executive Package, Driving Assistance Professional, Harman Kardon surround sound, a head-up display, and Laserlight headlights. As a new demonstrator unit it shows just 28 delivery miles and is backed by BMW's 4-year/50,000-mile new-vehicle warranty with complimentary scheduled maintenance. EPA-estimated fuel economy is 16 city / 23 highway / 19 combined mpg.

specs.warranty: 4-year / 50,000-mile new-vehicle limited warranty, 3-year / 36,000-mile complimentary scheduled maintenance, and 12-year unlimited-mile rust perforation coverage

description: A roomy three-row family SUV with all-wheel drive and seating for up to eight, the 2022 Toyota Highlander XLE is the practical, reliable choice for road trips, car pools, and growing families. Comfortable second-row captain's-style space, a big cargo area behind the third row, and Toyota's reputation for low cost of ownership make it an easy daily driver. Strong safety scores, blind-spot monitoring, and a smooth 295-hp V6 returning around 24 mpg combined.

The 2021 Honda Pilot EX-L is a spacious eight-seat family SUV built for hauling kids, gear, and everything in between. Three rows of comfortable seating, a flexible cargo hold, and standard Honda Sensing driver-assist make it a dependable family hauler for school runs and weekend trips. Smooth V6 power, available all-wheel drive for bad weather, and a leather cabin with heated seats.

Part rugged SUV, part efficient wagon, the 2021 Subaru Outback Premium is the go-anywhere family and adventure vehicle. Standard all-wheel drive, 8.7 inches of ground clearance, and X-MODE make it confident in snow, rain, and light off-road trails, while the comfortable five-seat cabin and big cargo area handle camping gear and dog crates. Great visibility, top safety ratings, and roughly 29 mpg combined.

features: All-wheel drive with locking center differential
Smart Cruise Control with Stop & Go
description: This 2022 Kia Telluride S is an all-wheel-drive three-row family SUV powered by a 3.8-liter Lambda II V6 producing 291 horsepower and 262 lb-ft of torque, paired with an 8-speed automatic. It seats eight, sprints from 0 to 60 mph in about 7.1 seconds, and returns an EPA-estimated 19 city / 24 highway / 21 combined mpg from its 18.8-gallon tank. Finished in Ebony Black over Black SynTex synthetic leather, it is well equipped with a power dual sunroof, wireless phone charger, Highway Driving Assist, Smart Cruise Control with Stop & Go, Blind-Spot Collision Avoidance Assist, heated front seats, a power liftgate, and wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto. Showing 27,300 miles and still covered by Kia’s 10-year/100,000-mile limited powertrain warranty, it blends near-luxury comfort with serious practicality and standout value.

specs.warranty: Kia 10-year / 100,000-mile limited powertrain warranty and 5-year / 60,000-mile limited basic warranty (from original in-service date)
options: Smart Cruise Control with Stop & Go

description: The ultimate family hauler, the 2020 Honda Odyssey EX-L minivan seats eight with sliding doors that make loading kids and car seats effortless. Magic Slide seats reconfigure for cargo or passengers, rear entertainment keeps kids happy, and CabinWatch lets you keep an eye on the back rows. Comfortable, safe, and built for family road trips and daily school runs.

The 2021 Toyota Sienna XLE is a hybrid family minivan that delivers around 36 mpg while seating up to eight. Power sliding doors, a flexible interior, and Toyota Safety Sense make it a fuel-efficient, low-running-cost choice for families who want minivan space without the gas-guzzling. Quiet, comfortable, and ultra-reliable for daily duty and long highway trips.

The safe, affordable, cheap-to-own 2020 Toyota Corolla LE is the perfect first car or no-fuss commuter. Excellent fuel economy around 32 mpg combined, bulletproof reliability, standard Toyota Safety Sense, and a comfortable easy-to-drive cabin. Low insurance, low maintenance, and a car that just won't quit — ideal for students, new drivers, and budget-minded buyers.

Fun to drive yet efficient, the 2021 Honda Civic Sport is a compact sedan that nails the balance of sporty handling, great fuel economy near 34 mpg, and everyday practicality. A roomy interior, modern tech, and Honda's reliability make it a fantastic commuter or first car for someone who still wants a little driving enjoyment. Sharp looks and a strong resale reputation.

The 2021 Mazda3 Select punches above its price with a near-luxury interior and genuinely engaging handling. A great-looking compact sedan that's efficient around 31 mpg, well-equipped, and more upscale-feeling than typical economy cars — a smart pick for a stylish commuter or a refined first car that doesn't feel cheap.

The 2022 Honda Accord Sport is a roomy, sharp-looking midsize sedan that drives younger than it is. Spacious for families and commuters alike, efficient around 30 mpg, and loaded with leather, a sunroof, and wireless charging. A comfortable, reliable do-everything sedan with a big trunk and a strong turbo engine.

The 2021 Toyota Camry SE is the benchmark reliable midsize sedan — comfortable, efficient near 32 mpg, and famously dependable. A spacious cabin and trunk make it great for families and commuters, while the SE's sport-tuned suspension adds a bit of fun. Low ownership costs and rock-solid resale value.

The 2020 Ford F-150 XLT SuperCrew is a full-size work-and-tow truck with serious capability. The 3.5L EcoBoost V6 delivers strong towing up to around 13,000 lbs, 4x4 handles job sites and bad weather, and the roomy crew cab seats the whole crew. Perfect for contractors, towing boats or trailers, and anyone who needs a hard-working pickup.

The 2021 Toyota Tacoma TRD Off-Road is a midsize trail-ready pickup built for adventure. Locking rear differential, Crawl Control, skid plates, and a beefed-up suspension make it genuinely capable off-road, while Toyota reliability and famous resale value keep it sensible. A great choice for overlanding, weekend trails, and daily duty alike.

The 2020 Jeep Wrangler Sport S is the iconic open-air off-roader — removable doors and top, trail-rated 4x4, and serious capability on rocks, sand, and mud. Rugged, fun, and endlessly customizable, it's the obvious pick for off-road enthusiasts and anyone who wants a vehicle with personality and go-anywhere ability.

The 2020 Porsche 718 Cayman S is a perfectly balanced mid-engine sports car — a pure driver's machine. Its 350-hp turbocharged flat-four and lightning PDK transmission deliver thrilling performance, while the mid-engine layout gives it razor-sharp handling. Low miles, Sport Chrono, and Bose audio. A weekend toy and track-day star that's still usable daily.

The 2019 Ford Mustang GT is a classic American muscle coupe with a roaring 5.0L V8 making 460 horsepower and a proper 6-speed manual. Active exhaust, Brembo brakes, and launch control make it a fast, fun, attainable performance car for someone who wants V8 thrills and a stick shift without supercar money.

The 2021 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray is a mid-engine American supercar bargain. Its 495-hp 6.2L V8 launches it to 60 mph in under 3 seconds, with exotic looks and handling for a fraction of European supercar prices. Low miles, removable roof, and a stunning Torch Red finish — a head-turning fast weekend car that's surprisingly livable.

The 2022 Tesla Model 3 Long Range is an efficient, quick all-electric sedan with around 330 miles of range and dual-motor all-wheel drive. Zero gas, low running costs, rapid 0-60 near 4.2 seconds, Autopilot, and access to the Supercharger network. A tech-forward EV that's perfect for commuters who want to ditch gas without sacrificing performance or range.

The 2021 Ford Mustang Mach-E Premium is an all-electric SUV that blends EV efficiency with family practicality. Around 270 miles of range, dual-motor AWD for all-weather grip, a roomy five-seat cabin with a panoramic roof, and a front trunk for extra storage. A gas-free crossover that's quick, spacious, and ideal for an eco-minded family or commuter.

The 2021 Lexus RX 350 Premium is a refined luxury SUV known for its whisper-quiet cabin, plush ride, and legendary Lexus reliability. All-wheel drive, heated and ventilated leather seats, and a long list of comfort features make it a sumptuous yet sensible family luxury crossover. Low maintenance, strong resale, and upscale without being flashy.

The 2021 Audi Q5 Premium Plus is a premium compact luxury SUV with standard Quattro all-wheel drive and a high-tech, beautifully built cabin. The digital Virtual Cockpit, leather seats, and panoramic roof deliver an upscale feel, while the efficient turbo and AWD make it a confident all-weather daily. A great blend of luxury, tech, and practicality.

Tiny on the outside, huge on the inside — the 2018 Honda Fit LX is a perfect cheap first car or city commuter. Class-leading interior space thanks to Magic Seats, excellent fuel economy around 36 mpg, and Honda dependability at a budget price. Easy to park, cheap to insure and maintain, and endlessly practical for students and new drivers.

The 2021 Hyundai Elantra SEL is a budget-friendly compact sedan with standout styling and outstanding fuel economy near 37 mpg. A surprisingly spacious cabin, modern tech, standard safety features, and Hyundai's strong remaining warranty make it a smart, affordable choice for a first car or value commuter.
